product_overview: Civic Journey is an interactive Next.js frontend that teaches the public how to vote through animated visuals, a scrollable timeline, a practice mock ballot, and a gamification engine to reward civic learning.
core_goals: Educate users on the election and voting process with clear, interactive UI components.
Provide a safe, stateful mock ballot so users can practice casting votes without consequence.
Increase civic engagement using a lightweight gamification system (points, badges, rewards).
Deliver a polished, performant experience using TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.

features.name: Animated Hero
features.description: A code-driven SVG animation for the landing hero section that loads animation config and assets, and reports load/usage for analytics. Uses Framer Motion for runtime animation.
user_flows: GET /api/animations/hero-config -> Receive 200 with animation configuration JSON -> GET /api/animations/hero-assets?version=stable -> Receive 200 with array of asset URLs -> POST /api/analytics/event with {event:'hero_shown', variant:'stable'} -> Receive 201 with event id

GET /api/animations/hero-config -> Receive 500 server error -> GET /api/animations/hero-fallback -> Receive 200 with static hero image URL -> POST /api/analytics/event with {event:'hero_load_error'} -> Receive 201 with event id

features.name: Scroll Timeline
features.description: Vertical scroll timeline showing process cards that describe each step in the election workflow; timeline data is fetched and can be revalidated.
user_flows: GET /api/timeline/steps -> Receive 200 with steps array -> GET /api/content/step/1 -> Receive 200 with step detail payload -> POST /api/analytics/event with {event:'timeline_view', stepId:1} -> Receive 201

GET /api/timeline/steps -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> POST /api/auth/refresh with {refreshToken} -> Receive 200 with new access token -> GET /api/timeline/steps with Authorization header -> Receive 200 with steps array

features.name: Interactive Mock Ballot
features.description: A stateful mock ballot UI where users can make selections, preview their ballot, and submit a simulated vote to trigger practice success animations and feedback.
user_flows: GET /api/mockballot/session -> Receive 200 with {sessionId, expiry} -> POST /api/mockballot/selection with {sessionId, selectionList} -> Receive 200 with preview state -> POST /api/mockballot/submit with {sessionId} -> Receive 200 with {confirmation:'accepted', animation:'success'}
GET /api/mockballot/session -> Receive 429 Too Many Requests -> Wait/retry after Retry-After -> GET /api/mockballot/session -> Receive 200 with session id

POST /api/mockballot/selection with {sessionId, invalidSelection} -> Receive 400 with validation error -> POST /api/analytics/event with {event:'mockballot_selection_error', errorCode:'INVALID_SELECTION'} -> Receive 201

features.name: Gamification Engine
features.description: Context provider and client-side tracker that awards points and badges for civic actions (e.g., completing mock ballot). Supports querying status and claiming rewards.
user_flows: GET /api/rewards/status?userId=me -> Receive 200 with {points, badges, nextReward} -> POST /api/rewards/track with {event:'completed_mock_ballot'} -> Receive 201 with {pointsAwarded} -> GET /api/rewards/status?userId=me -> Receive 200 with updated points and badge list

POST /api/rewards/track with {event:'completed_mock_ballot'} -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> POST /api/auth/login with {username,password} -> Receive 200 with JWT -> POST /api/rewards/track with Authorization header and same event -> Receive 201 with {pointsAwarded}
POST /api/rewards/claim with {badgeId} -> Receive 409 with {error:'already_claimed'} -> GET /api/rewards/status?userId=me -> Receive 200 to confirm badge already claimed
